title: Rebirths

{{Quote | text = Rebirth trades progress for permanent upgrades. | speaker = Zibbu }}{{Rebirth|image1=Rebirth Logo.png|title1=Rebirths}} '''''Rebirths''''' is the main progression system in ''Star Wars: Droid Tycoon''. To perform a rebirth, players must meet certain requirements, such as owning specific droids and reaching a required amount of credits. There are currently 35 rebirth levels that are separated into 6 paths. __TOC__ == What are Rebirths? == Rebirth is a prestige-style progression system in Fortnite Star Wars Droid Tycoon. Players can rebirth at the rebirth station. The player unlocks the rebirth station after purchasing the shipyard and firing range, afterwards they have to buy the station for 4K credits. Each Rebirth level requires you to accumulate a specific number of credits and have particular Droids actively deployed in your base. Checking a Droid off in your Droidex is not enough; the Droids must be active, though they can be assigned to the lounge rather than actively working. For each rebirth, the player must obtain three specific droids or higher-quality versions of those droids. For example, if a Gold [[R9]] is required, a Diamond R9 can also be used to meet the requirement. Owning a [[Droid Fusion|fusion]] exclusive droid can help you complete multiple droid requirements at the same time. For instance, because [[RIV-3T]] is made from a [[RIC]], a [[KX]], and an [[IG]], just owning one RIV-3T will completely fill the rebirth requirements for the RIC, the KX, and the IG all at once. The player must also have a specific amount of credits to perform a rebirth. However, all credits are reset after rebirthing. After a rebirth the players receive several benefits: * Credit Multipliers * XP Multipliers * Offline Generation per hour * Increased Crit Chance & Crit Amount * +Credits from Offline Generation * More workslot areas * More lounge space * Nova Crystals * Weapons from the Weapon Rack Starting from Rebirth 36 (path 1-5) and much earlier on Path 6, the {{Variant|Kyber}} variant is required. Kyber features four unique variants: Inactive, Green, Blue, and Purple. Only active Kyber droid (green, blue and purple) can be used to meet the Rebirth requirement. Although the {{Variant|Scourge}} variant isn't required for rebirth, it counts toward all other variant requirements. For example, if you need to obtain a {{Variant|Kyber}} Gonk, a {{Variant|Scourge}} Gonk will also meet that requirement. == Super Rebirth == ''Read more about Super Rebirths on [[Super Rebirth|this page]].'' If the player has reached '''rebirth 12''' and owns a {{Variant|Rainbow}} '''or higher variant''' {{Official:Rarity|Legendary}} '''droid''', the player can [[Super Rebirth|'''Super Rebirth''']] at the super rebirth area behind the cantina to earn Nova Crystals, reaching a higher rebirth level increases the amount of Nova Crystals thus the more upgrades the player can purchase at the [[Nova Shop|'''Nova Shop''']]. For the full list of the amount of Nova Crystals each rebirth gives, check the Super Rebirth page. If the player has super rebirthed, the droid requirements changes for each rebirth level. There are currently 6 different paths/waves of droid rebirth requirements. Compleating path 2 of the rebirth cycle will send the player into path 3 etc. After path 6, the player will be sent back to path 1. Note that only the droid requirements change and not the credits amount. The player can check their current rebirth path on the top right of the rebirth screen. == Droid and Credit Requirements == Down here is a list of all droid and credit rebirth requirements for all 5 paths. Next to each droid you will notice a number. This number means that the droid is later required for another rebirth requirement. * ¹ = {{Variant|Gold}} variant is required for a later rebirth. * ² = {{Variant|Diamond}} variant is required for a later rebirth. * ³ = {{Variant|Rainbow}} variant is required for a later rebirth. * ⁴ = {{Variant|Beskar}} variant is required for a later rebirth. * ⁵ = {{Variant|Galactic}} variant is required for a later rebirth. * ⁶ = {{Variant|Stellar}} variant is required for a later rebirth. * ⁷ = Any active {{Variant|Kyber}} variant is required for a later rebirth. * ⁻ = Same or lower variant is required for a later rebirth.
